body: Clarification on the absent-receipt law: the strongest public API makes absence unrepresentable (only evidence-consuming checked is public), so no absent payload can reach evaluate. To exercise evaluate specifically, I can retain a private[embed] legacy-v1 fixture constructor used only by PrivacySuite; evaluate denies it, while external compileErrors prove callers cannot construct/copy/drop receipts. I do not recommend a public v1/absent constructor because it would recreate the laundering seam. Is that the intended test seam?
